releases.body:
First release published from CI with npm provenance. Install with `opencode plugin add opencode-livetrace`.

## What's Changed
* Add README screenshots and fix indicator flicker by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/pull/1
* Rename plugin to opencode-activity by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/pull/2
* build: bundle the plugin for npm publishing by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/pull/3
* docs: fix typo in README by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/pull/4
* feat: show only the live phase in the footer by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/pull/5
* docs: refresh screenshots with the context size by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/pull/6
* feat: new turn and step glyphs after the counts by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/pull/7
* fix: show activity even if the first load fails by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/pull/8
* docs: add MIT license by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/pull/9
* refactor: rename plugin to opencode-livetrace by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/pull/10
* ci: publish to npm on version tags by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/pull/11
* build: release 0.1.1 by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/pull/12

## New Contributors
* @belambert made their first contribution in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/belambert/opencode-livetrace/commits/v0.1.1
